items.title: 33.3 Common Water Pollutants (pani ke aam pollutants) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 33.3 (PDF 250-254); the eutrophication and oil drawings are our own.

blocks.text: 1. Microbiological Pollutants (khurdbeeni jaraseem wali gandagi)

Microbiological pollution ka matlab hai pani mein harmful (nuqsan-deh) microorganisms (khurdbeeni jaandaar) ka aa jana, jaise bacteria, viruses, protozoa aur parasites. Yeh insanon aur janwaron ki sehat ke liye sakht khatra hain. Yeh pollution aam taur par tab hoti hai jab bina saaf kiya ya theek se saaf na kiya gaya sewage, animal waste (janwaron ka fuzla), hospital ka waste aur kheton se behta pani (runoff) daryaon waghera mein jata hai. Aise pani mein aam pathogens (bimari phailane wale jaraseem) Escherichia coli, Salmonella aur Giardia hain. Pani ke bacteria, viruses aur protozoa hi pani se phailne wali bimariyon (water-borne diseases) ki bari wajah hain, jaise cholera, typhoid, dysentery (pechish) aur hepatitis A.

blocks.alt: Aag par rakha pani ka bartan, oopar Boiling Water (100 °C) likha hai aur bhaap uth rahi hai. Pani mein bacteria, virus aur narangi toote hue tukre hain. Pani ki satah se lakeer Intact Bacteria/Virus (sabit jarasim) tak, aur aag se lakeer Broken Microbe Structure (toote hue jarasim) tak jati hai.
blocks.caption: Ubalne se zyada tar bacteria, viruses aur protozoa mar jate aur pani peene ke qabil hota hai, magar doosre pollutants sirf ubalne se door nahi hote (kitab ki tasveer ke mutabiq hamari drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: 100 °C par garmi jaraseem ka structure (banawat) tor deti hai: oopar 'Intact' sabit jarasim hain, neeche 'Broken' toote hue. Lekin heavy metals, nitrates ya pesticides ubalne se khatam nahi hote, balke pani bhaap bane to un ka concentration thora barh jata hai.
2. Chemical Pollutants (Heavy Metals aur Pesticides)
a) Heavy Metals

Is pollution mein aksar zehreeli heavy metals hoti hain, jaise mercury, lead, arsenic aur cadmium, aur kheti ke chemicals jaise pesticides aur herbicides. Heavy metals industrial discharge (factories ka ganda pani), mining (kaan-kani) aur improper waste disposal (kachra ghalat tareeqe se phenkna) se pani mein aati hain. Kuch heavy metals ke sources neeche hain.

items: Mercury zyada tar koyla jalane (coal combustion), sone ki kaan-kani aur thermometer ya battery banane wali factories ke waste se pani mein aati hai. Aquatic sediments (pani ki tah ki mitti) mein bacteria inorganic mercury ko methylmercury ([CH₃Hg]⁺) mein badal dete hain, jo zyada khatarnak hai.

Lead ke bare sources: leaded petrol (ab poori duniya mein band), purane lead ke pipes (plumbing), lead-acid batteries aur paints. Lead ions (Pb²⁺) aksar pipes ke zang lagne (corrosion) se pani mein aate hain.

Metal plating, plastic stabilisers aur phosphate fertilizer ki impurities (milawat) pani mein cadmium ke bare sources hain. Yeh chemicals non-biodegradable (qudrati taur par khatam na hone wale) hain aur food chain mein jama ho kar aquatic life (pani ke jaandaron) aur insanon dono ke liye long-term (lambe arse ka) khatra bante hain.

blocks.text: Health effects of Heavy Metals (heavy metals ke sehat par asraat)

Heavy metals ke atomic weights aur densities zyada hote hain. Yeh non-biodegradable hain (khud nahi galti), is liye jandaron ke tissues mein jama hoti jati hain aur khaas taur par khatarnak hain. Kuch aam heavy metals aur un ke nuqsanat:

items: Methyl mercury ([CH₃Hg]⁺) fat (charbi) mein bohat ghulti hai, is liye aasani se biological membranes (cell ki jhilliyan) paar kar leti hai aur biomagnification karti hai (food chain mein oopar jate hue barhti hai). Yeh potent (taqatwar) neurotoxin (nervous system ka zehr) hai jo blood-brain barrier bhi paar kar leta hai. Lambe arse tak is ka samna Minamata disease laata hai: ataxia (chalne mein balance bigarna), hathon pairon ka sun hona (numbness) aur general muscle weakness (aam patthon ki kamzori).

Lead haemoglobin banne mein rukawat dalta hai, jis se anaemia (khoon ki kami) hoti hai. Bachon mein yeh cumulative (jama hota rehne wala) poison hai jo irreversible neurological damage (dimagh aur nervous system ko aisa nuqsan jo theek nahi hota) deta hai, aur un ki development (nashonuma) der se hoti hai.

Cadmium (Cd) lambe arse tak jism mein jaye to “Itai-itai” bimari hoti hai: cadmium haddiyon mein calcium ki jagah le leta hai aur haddiyan bohat brittle (bhurbhuri) ho jati hain. Is se kidneys (gurdon) ko bhi sakht nuqsan (nephrotoxicity) hota hai.

blocks.alt: Baen taraf bara halka neela gola Ca2+, beech mein daen taraf teer jis par Ionic Displacement Potential likha hai, aur daen taraf chhota gehra neela gola Cd2+.
blocks.caption: Cd2+ ki charge density zyada hai, is liye yeh haddiyon mein Ca2+ ki jagah le leta hai (kitab ki tasveer ke mutabiq hamari drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Dono ions ka charge 2+ hai. Cd2+ (taqreeban 95 pm) Ca2+ (taqreeban 100 pm) se thora chhota hai, is liye us ki charge density thori zyada hai aur woh haddi mein calcium ki jagahon par baith jata hai. Kitab ki drawing mein size ka farq bara dikhaya gaya hai; asal mein dono ions qareeb qareeb barabar hain, isi liye Cd2+ itni aasani se fit hota hai.
Kuch heavy metals ki limiting concentrations (zyada se zyada ijazat wali miqdar, mg/L) Table 33.2 mein di gayi hain.

blocks.title: Did You Know? (kya aap jante hain?)
blocks.text: Minamata Disaster 1950 ki dahai mein Minamata, Japan mein industrial pollution ka ek bohat bura (severe) waqia tha. Pani mein methylmercury chhori gayi, jis se bohat logon ko mercury ka zehr (mercury poisoning) hua: hazaron log neurological damage (dimagh aur nervous system ke nuqsan) ka shikar hue, birth defects (bachay naqais paida hona) aur deaths (mautein) huin, aur environmental devastation (mahol ki tabahi) hui. (Kitab is box mein ek mareez ki photo bhi deti hai; woh yahan shamil nahi.)
a) Pesticides and Herbicides (keere aur jari-bootiyan maarne wale chemicals)

DDT aur Glyphosate jaise pesticides aur herbicides ek aur hazardous (khatarnak) cheez hain jo pani ko ganda karte aur insan ki sehat ke sangeen masail paida karte hain. In ke bare sources kheton ka behta pani (agricultural runoff) aur domestic gardening (gharon ki baghbani) hain. DDT non-polar hai aur pani mein taqreeban nahi ghulta, lekin machhliyon aur parindon ke charbi wale tissues mein bohat ghulta hai. DDT jaise bohat se purane pesticides persistent organic pollutants (POPs) hain, yani der tak khatam na hone wale organic pollutants. Pesticides hormonal disruption (hormones ka bigarna) aur developmental problems (barhne ke masail) se jure hain. Chemical pollution pani ki quality bhi girati hai, biodiversity (jaandaron ki qismon ki tadaad) kam karti hai aur aquatic ecosystems ko bigarti hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab DDT aur Glyphosate dono ko “non-polar aur pani mein na ghulne wale” kehti hai. Yeh DDT par sahi hai, lekin glyphosate polar hai aur pani mein bohat ghulta hai. (33.1 mein bhi kitab kehti hai ke polar pesticides pani mein ghul kar water cycle mein jate hain.)
Health Effects (sehat par asraat)

Bohat se pesticides endocrine disruptors hain: yeh qudrati hormones, jaise estrogen, ki tarah kaam karte hain. Is se wildlife (jangli jaandaron) mein reproductive failure (bachay paida karne ki nakami) hoti hai (misal: parindon ke ande ka chhilka patla ho jana), aur insanon mein hormones se jure cancers se in ka talluq hai. Polychlorinated biphenyls (PCBs) bijli ke transformers mein coolant (thanda karne wala) ke taur par use hote rahe hain; yeh khatarnak waste ki jagahon se pani mein riste hain. PCBs ko “probable human carcinogens” (shayad insan mein cancer karne wale) mana jata hai. Yeh immune system (jism ka bimari se larne wala system) ko suppress (kamzor) karte hain aur skin conditions (jild ki bimariyan), jaise chloracne, paida karte hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab “Polychlorinated biphenols” likhti hai. Sahi naam polychlorinated biphenyls (PCBs) hai: yeh biphenyl (C₁₂H₁₀) ke chlorine wale derivatives hain. Biphenols compounds ki alag class hai.

blocks.alt: Insani jism ke aaza (organs), ran ka patha, tang ki haddi aur baazu ki khoon ki naliyan. Oopar baen spray karta shakhs (Pesticides), daen Cd, Pb, Cu, Zn ke saath Heavy Metals; dono se teer jism ki taraf. Labels: Alzheimer (dimagh); baen: Cardiac Failure, Lung Cancer, Hepatic Necrosis, Ovarian Cancer, Musculoskeletal Diseases; daen: Reducing Thyroid Hormone, Intravascular Hemolysis, Vomiting/Diarrhea, Renal Dysfunction, Osteoporosis.
blocks.caption: Figure 33.2: Heavy metals aur pesticides ke insani jism par asraat (kitab ki Figure 33.2 ke mutabiq hamari drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har label ki lakeer us organ (uzw) se nikalti hai jise nuqsan hota hai: dil (cardiac failure), phephre (lung cancer), jigar (hepatic necrosis), thyroid (hormone kam), khoon (haemolysis), maida (ulti ya dast), gurde (renal dysfunction), haddi (osteoporosis).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 33.2 mein Pesticides aur jism ke darmiyan teer dono taraf nok wala (double-headed) chhapa hai. Zehr sirf jism mein jata hai, is liye yahan Heavy Metals ki tarah ek taraf ka teer banaya gaya hai.
3. Eutrophication

Nutrient pollution ko eutrophication bhi kehte hain. Yeh tab hoti hai jab nutrients (paudon ki ghiza), khaas taur par nitrogen aur phosphorus, bohat zyada miqdar mein pani mein chale jate hain; yeh aam taur par kheton ke behte pani, ganday pani (wastewater) aur toofani barish ke pani se aate hain. Yeh nutrients paudon ke barhne ke liye zaroori hain, lekin aquatic environments (pani) mein in ki excess (zyadti) se algae bohat tezi se barhti hai, jise algal bloom kehte hain. Yeh blooms pani ke andar ke paudon tak dhoop pohanchne nahi dete. Jab algae mar kar galti hai to bohat si oxygen kharch hoti hai, aur hypoxic (kam oxygen wale) “dead zones” bante hain jahan aquatic life (pani ki zindagi) zinda nahi reh sakti. Eutrophication aquatic ecosystems ko bigarti hai, biodiversity kam karti hai, fisheries (machhli ke karobar) ko nuqsan deti hai, aur pani ko peene aur recreation (tafreeh) ke laiq nahi rehne deti. Peene ke pani mein zyada nitrate khaas taur par chhote bachon (infants) ke liye khatarnak hai: is se “Blue Baby Syndrome” (Methaemoglobinaemia) ho sakta hai, jis mein nitrates khoon ki oxygen le jane ki salahiyat kam kar dete hain.

blocks.alt: Paanch dabbe teeron se jure: zyada N aur P (khaad, sewage); algae ki tez barhotri (bloom); bloom dhoop rok leta hai; murda algae gal kar oxygen kharch karti; dead zone jahan aquatic life (pani ki zindagi) mar jati.
blocks.caption: Eutrophication ka silsila (hamari drawing; kitab ki Figure 33.3(a) photo hai).

blocks.text: 4. Oil (tel)

Samandaron mein tel ki pollution, khaas taur par jahazon se oil leaks (tel ka rasna) aur spills (tel girna) se, environment ke liye bara khatra hai. Jab tel ghalti se samandar mein gir jata hai to pani ki satah par tezi se phail kar ek tah (layer) bana leta hai jo dhoop rokti hai aur oxygen exchange (hawa aur pani mein oxygen ka len-den) kam karti hai. Is se machhliyon, parindon aur mammals samet marine life (samandari zindagi) ko sakht nuqsan hota hai. Samandari mammals apna jism saaf karte (grooming) hue zehreela tel nigal lete hain, aur hydrocarbons ke samne rehne se machhliyon ki sehat ko lamba nuqsan ho sakta hai. Tel ki pollution coastal habitats (sahil par jaandaron ke rehne ki jagahon), jaise mangroves, coral reefs aur beaches, ko bhi kharab karti hai.

blocks.alt: Pani ki satah par tel ki kaali tah. Suraj ki roshni ka teer tah par ruk jata (laal X), aur O2 ka teer bhi pani mein dakhil nahi hota (laal X). Neeche pani mein machhli.
blocks.caption: Tel ki tah dhoop aur oxygen rokti hai (hamari drawing; kitab ki Figure 33.3(b) photo hai).

blocks.title: Figure 33.3
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 33.3 do photos hain: (a) eutrophication wale pani mein mari hui machhliyan, (b) tel mein lipta hua pelican parinda. Oopar ki dono drawings hamari apni hain.
5. Plastic and Solid Waste (plastic aur thos kachra)

Samandaron aur doosri water bodies mein plastic aur solid waste (thos kachre) ki pollution ek barhta hua environmental crisis (mahol ka bohran) hai. Har saal karoron ton plastic, jaise botlein, shopper, machhli ke jaal aur microplastics (plastic ke bohat barik particles), daryaon, jheelon aur samandaron mein phenka jata hai. Organic cheezon ke bar-aks plastic qudrati taur par nahi galta (biodegrade nahi hota); yeh chhote chhote tukron mein toot kar sadiyon tak mahol mein rehta hai.

Samandari janwar aksar plastic ko khana samajh lete hain; use nigalne se dam ghut sakta hai ya andar chot lag sakti hai, jo jaan-leva ho sakti hai. Kabhi purane machhli ke jaal aur samandar ki tah ke doosre malbe mein phans kar be-shumar samandari jandaar, jaise kachhuay, dolphins aur parinde, zakhmi ho jate ya mar jate hain. Microplastics food chain mein bhi dakhil ho chuke hain, is liye insani sehat par in ke asar ki fikr hai. Solid waste (thos kachra) waterways (pani ke raaste) band karta hai, aquatic habitats (pani ke jaandaron ke ghar) bigarta hai aur pani ki quality girata hai.
Quick Check 33.3

blocks.prompt: i. Heavy metals ke sources batayein.
blocks.explanation: Industry ka ganda pani, mining aur waste ka ghalat phenkna. Mercury: koyla jalana, sone ki kaan-kani, thermometer aur battery ki factories. Lead: leaded petrol, lead ke pipes, lead-acid batteries, paints. Cadmium: metal plating, plastic stabilisers, phosphate fertilizer ki impurities.

blocks.prompt: ii. Tel ka girna (oil spill) samandari zindagi ke liye kaise khatarnak hai?
blocks.explanation: Tel ki tah dhoop rokti aur oxygen exchange kam karti hai; mammals grooming karte hue zehreela tel nigal lete hain; machhliyon ko hydrocarbons se lamba nuqsan hota hai; mangroves, coral reefs aur beaches kharab hote hain.

blocks.prompt: iii. DDT jaise pesticides “non-polar aur pani mein na ghulne wale” hain, phir bhi pani ko ganda kar ke sehat ke sangeen masail paida karte hain. Samjhayein.
blocks.explanation: DDT ki bohat thori miqdar pani mein ghulti hai, aur runoff (behte pani) mein mitti ke particles se chipak kar bhi pani tak pohanchti hai. Yeh charbi mein ghulta aur der tak khatam nahi hota, is liye machhliyon ke charbi wale tissues mein jama hota hai aur food chain ke har qadam par barhta hai (biomagnification). Is tarah oopar ke jandaar aur insan zyada miqdar lete hain.

blocks.text: Summary (khulasa)

items: Microbiological pollutants: E. coli, Salmonella, Giardia; cholera, typhoid, dysentery, hepatitis A; ubalne se jaraseem marte hain, doosri pollution nahi.
Heavy metals: Hg (Minamata disease), Pb (anaemia), Cd (Itai-itai); WHO ki hadd Table 33.2 mein.
Pesticides aur PCBs: hormones ka bigar, cancers; eutrophication: algal bloom aur dead zones; tel ki tah; plastic aur microplastics.
